title: HAVEN GORE-TEX 3L Pinnacle Weather Protection
about: Introducing the Condor Jacket and the Chamber Parka, a testament to our commitment to providing you with versatile outerwear that doesn’t compromise on comfort or aesthetic. Whether you’re navigating city streets or embracing the great outdoors, these jackets are designed to be your go-to choice for every occasion. Discover innovative design and everyday wearability in our GORE-TEX 3-layer outerwear.

title: HAVEN Loro Piana Range
about: An Italian icon and one of the world’s most esteemed fabric mill’s Loro Piana draws on both time-honored traditions and state of the art technology to create their exquisite fabrics. Not your average tech fabric, Loro Piana Storm System® is one of our favorite technologies, combining wind and water protection with comfort, breathability and a timeless natural appearance.

title: HAVEN Suvin Cotton Range
about: When we began development on our ‘Prime’ range of year-round, staple sweaters and t-shirts, our first goal was finding a fabric that was ultra-soft yet structural and luxurious yet durable enough for daily wear. After sampling various cottons and blends from around the world one stood out above the rest; a rare breed of cotton from India known as Suvin.

title: HAVEN Duca Visconti Corduroy Range
about: An iconic fabric that has withstood the test of time thanks to its comfort, durability and timeless appearance, corduroy has a rich history and has been favoured by all strata of society from factory workers and soldiers to artists, musicians and nobility. What makes corduroy unique is its ribbed, pile weave which creates a three-dimensional surface, imbuing the fabric with an ultra-soft handfeel and subtle luxurious sheen akin to velvet.

title: HAVEN SS22 Schoeller® Dryskin Range
about: This season we redeploy one of our favorite and most versatile fabrics — Schoeller® Dryskin, applying it to a range of outdoor inspired garments and accessories. Manufactured in Switzerland, Dryskin is a highly-functional fabric with a unique and luxurious appearance and feel.
